model.update: one autonomous deterministic map F with S(k+1)=F(S(k))

proof_kernel: equal states have equal complete future traces under deterministic iteration
equal decoded traces give a rotational symmetry of the cyclic parity word
the odd-cycle parity word has one unique equal-sign seam and therefore trivial rotational stabilizer
closed_classes: any autonomous exact phase automaton with fewer than n states
not_closed: poly(log n)-bit field-valued states with at least n values
direct parity decoders not generated by repeated +G transport
